craft_notes: Sthāyin: emission grounded. Rows: pour, praise, ground. Read aloud: trumpet then proof.

lines: So bright Aghoreśa pours for the bliss of the pierced by thing-hunger's tale —
well-sung truth; for the taint's stir
comes from the Highest's wish alone; alone the dead cannot anywhere.
l4.sanskrit_cite: pralayakevalasya tu jṛmbhamāṇa eva āsta iti malopodbalitaṃ karma saṃsāravaicitryabhoge nimittam iti tadbhogavāsanānuviddhānām aṇūnāṃ bhogasiddhaye śrīmān aghoreśaḥ sṛjati iti yuktam uktaṃ malasya ca prakṣobha īśvarecchābalād eva jaḍasya svataḥ kutracid api asāmarthyāt
